info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Currency Distribution API facilitates the retrieval of currency distribution data for specific banking channels based on provided parameters. This endpoint allows users to gain insights into branch currency distribution, enabling better resource planning and management. Typical consumers of this API include banking analysts, financial planners, and application developers integrating currency distribution insights into their systems. Leverage this API to access detailed distribution metrics for enhanced decision-making and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve currency distribution for a specific branch.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the currency distribution data for a designated branch identified by its resource ID. It provides insights into the currency allocation across various channels within that branch, helping in financial analysis and decision making.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving branch currency distribution details specific to the RES-100045 channel. This body must be formatted as JSON and adheres to the specified schema.

GetChannelSpecificByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to branch currency distribution in the specified channel. It is expected to be a JSON formatted string.
